data.one_liner: Reachability and dead/unused declaration analysis for Dart and Flutter packages.
data.what_it_does: Performs whole-package AST analysis using package:analyzer to build a reachability graph from known entrypoints to internal declarations. Identifies unused top-level declarations, classes, functions, and variables, supporting both open-world library modes and closed-app executable analysis.
use_when: You want to audit your Dart or Flutter package for dead or unused code
You need automated CI checks to fail if dead code is introduced
You want to find internal declarations that can be safely made private
avoid_when: You are looking for runtime performance profiling rather than static dead code analysis
strengths: Supports dual analysis modes (open-world library and closed-app)
Framework adapters for Flutter, build_runner, and package test
Co-invoked test hazard protection to avoid false-positive test deletions
weaknesses: May require configuration for complex dynamic dependency injection or reflection-heavy code patterns
data.setup_notes: Can be run directly via CLI using dart run undead or embedded as a library in Dart scripts.
